title: Calculation of the Repayment Payment Due on an Inactive School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
**The payment.** The repayment payment on an inactive School Nutrition Services Meal Account is the account's unpaid meal charges in full, in a single payment of one (1) installment, that is the amount by which the account's balance is below zero.

**The balance.** The inactive account's balance for the repayment is its deposits, voids and transfers in less its purchases, refunds, transfers out and returned deposits, as they stand when the payment is quoted.

**How the payment is put together.** First the installments are counted: the installments set by the size of the charges (one, a single payment) together with every change made to them, all added together, the total never fewer than one. Then any part taken up front is set aside and the rest of the unpaid meal charges is divided by the installments, and the part taken up front is added back to that share. The repayment payment is that total rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, then raised to the online deposit minimum when it is below it, and never more than the unpaid meal charges or the online deposit maximum; an account whose unpaid meal charges are below the online deposit minimum owes no repayment payment through the portal.

The online deposit minimum (10.00) and maximum (300.00) are those of the deposit terms.

## Worked payments (hypothetical accounts)

| Account's balance | Unpaid meal charges | Repayment payment |
|---|---|---|
| 23.70 below zero | 23.70 | 23.70, in one installment |
| 12.00 below zero | 12.00 | 12.00 |
| 7.85 below zero | 7.85 | none through the portal: below the online deposit minimum |
| 3.40 | none | none |
